origin.description: Broyden's method for n nonlinear equations in n variables.
origin.usage: broyden(Ffun, x0, J0 = NULL, ..., maxiter = 100, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(1/2))

arguments.name: J0
arguments.text: Jacobian at the start. Numerical when omitted.

origin.value: Broyden's method for n nonlinear equations in n variables.
origin.example: print(with(broyden(function(x) x - c(1, 2), c(0, 0)), c(zero, fnorm)))

translation.description: Broyden's method for n nonlinear equations in n variables.

translation.value: Broyden's method for n nonlinear equations in n variables.
